description: Land Acquisition - Agbopura and Agbogama, Kantale D/S Division, Trincomalee District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition for public purposes under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (lots with boundaries and extents) being acquired, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters. While it mentions a government minister making the declaration, this is incidental to the core land-related content and does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger Types 1-3.
